profile_text.body:
Jamf, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, describes itself as a provider of Apple device management and security software. The company says it helps organizations manage Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Apple TV devices at any scale, connecting users to resources and protecting businesses from cyber threats. It claims over 20 years of experience, same-day Apple OS support, and positions itself as the only company offering a complete management and security solution for Apple-first enterprise environments. IDC MarketScape placed Jamf in the Leaders Category for its Worldwide Unified Endpoint Management Software for Apple Devices 2025–2026 Vendor Assessment.

On the AI side, Jamf tracks a product called Jamf AI Governance, categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform. The company describes it as a native AI control plane for macOS fleets, covering discovery and policy enforcement for both on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints, with general availability set for July 1, 2026.

The site's held facts show Jamf has a notable legal footprint, with 129 cases associated with Minnesota, though no specific litigation details are recorded. No MCP server registrations or SEC filings are present in the current data.
